name: model-router
description: Routes every Agent call but a fork to the cheapest model and effort tier that does it well (Haiku for lookups, Sonnet for standard coding, Opus for hard engineering), by a routing policy measured against gold labels and replayed as a test; /route auto on|off switches it, /route fable opens the Fable tier, and with auto routing off Claude picks from one agent type per tier with an Opus safety net
